chunks: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden; and He has knowledge of everything.

key_terms.الْآخِرُ: The Last, remaining after all else
key_terms.الْأَوَّلُ: The First, existing before all else

ai.seo_question: What are the four divine attributes mentioned in Surah Al-Hadid regarding Allah's existence and knowledge?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse is often recited as a supplication (du'a) by the Imams to affirm Allah's transcendence beyond spatial and temporal limitations. The duality of Al-Zahir and Al-Batin underscores the concept of divine immanence within creation while maintaining absolute essence, a key theme in Shia metaphysics. This comprehensive knowledge (Al-Alim) serves as the basis for divine providence and the eventual return of all things to their Origin.
